changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO construction_materials ( name_ru, name_pl, type_id, producer_id, seller_id, unit_id, currency_id, purchase_price, retail_gross, retail_net, website, active, created_date, created_by) SELECT 'Защитная малярная плёнка HDPE', 'Folia ochronna malarska HDPE', t.id, (SELECT id FROM material_producers WHERE name_pl = 'Technicqll' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1), u.id, c.id, 0.12, 0.22, 0.18, 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll', TRUE, NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM construction_material_types t, measurement_units u, currencies c WHERE t.code = 'FOLIA_OCHRONNA' AND u.code = 'm2' AND c.code = 'PLN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM construction_materials cm WHERE cm.name_pl = 'Folia ochronna malarska HDPE' AND cm.website IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll' AND cm.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1) AND cm.retail_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 0.18 );

INSERT INTO construction_materials ( name_ru, name_pl, type_id, producer_id, seller_id, unit_id, currency_id, purchase_price, retail_gross, retail_net, website, active, created_date, created_by) SELECT 'Гофрокартон малярный защитный', 'Tektura falista malarska ochronna', t.id, (SELECT id FROM material_producers WHERE name_pl = 'Technicqll' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'PSB Mrówka' LIMIT 1), u.id, c.id, 0.85, 1.49, 1.21, 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll', TRUE, NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM construction_material_types t, measurement_units u, currencies c WHERE t.code = 'TEKTURA_OCHRONNA' AND u.code = 'm2' AND c.code = 'PLN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM construction_materials cm WHERE cm.name_pl = 'Tektura falista malarska ochronna' AND cm.website IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll' AND cm.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'PSB Mrówka' LIMIT 1) AND cm.retail_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 1.21 );

INSERT INTO construction_materials ( name_ru, name_pl, type_id, producer_id, seller_id, unit_id, currency_id, purchase_price, retail_gross, retail_net, website, active, created_date, created_by) SELECT 'Малярная лента бумажная 38мм', 'Taśma malarska papierowa 38mm', t.id, (SELECT id FROM material_producers WHERE name_pl = 'Blue Dolphin' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1), u.id, c.id, 3.20, 5.49, 4.46, 'https://www.maldrew.com.pl/en/c/tools-and-protective-equipme/painting-articles/19', TRUE, NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM construction_material_types t, measurement_units u, currencies c WHERE t.code = 'TASMA_MALARSKA' AND u.code = 'szt' AND c.code = 'PLN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM construction_materials cm WHERE cm.name_pl = 'Taśma malarska papierowa 38mm' AND cm.website IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'https://www.maldrew.com.pl/en/c/tools-and-protective-equipme/painting-articles/19' AND cm.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1) AND cm.retail_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 4.46 );

INSERT INTO construction_materials ( name_ru, name_pl, type_id, producer_id, seller_id, unit_id, currency_id, purchase_price, retail_gross, retail_net, website, active, created_date, created_by) SELECT 'Штукатурная лента наружная 48мм', 'Taśma tynkarska zewnętrzna 48mm', t.id, (SELECT id FROM material_producers WHERE name_pl = 'Blue Dolphin' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1), u.id, c.id, 4.90, 7.99, 6.50, 'https://www.maldrew.com.pl/en/c/tools-and-protective-equipme/painting-articles/19', TRUE, NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM construction_material_types t, measurement_units u, currencies c WHERE t.code = 'TASMA_TYNKARSKA' AND u.code = 'szt' AND c.code = 'PLN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM construction_materials cm WHERE cm.name_pl = 'Taśma tynkarska zewnętrzna 48mm' AND cm.website IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'https://www.maldrew.com.pl/en/c/tools-and-protective-equipme/painting-articles/19' AND cm.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1) AND cm.retail_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 6.50 );

INSERT INTO construction_materials ( name_ru, name_pl, type_id, producer_id, seller_id, unit_id, currency_id, purchase_price, retail_gross, retail_net, website, active, created_date, created_by) SELECT 'Уголок картонный защитный', 'Narożnik papierowy ochronny', t.id, (SELECT id FROM material_producers WHERE name_pl = 'Technicqll' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'PSB Mrówka' LIMIT 1), u.id, c.id, 0.55, 0.99, 0.80, 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll', TRUE, NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM construction_material_types t, measurement_units u, currencies c WHERE t.code = 'NAROZNIK_OCHRONNY' AND u.code = 'szt' AND c.code = 'PLN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM construction_materials cm WHERE cm.name_pl = 'Narożnik papierowy ochronny' AND cm.website IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll' AND cm.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'PSB Mrówka' LIMIT 1) AND cm.retail_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 0.80 );

INSERT INTO construction_materials ( name_ru, name_pl, type_id, producer_id, seller_id, unit_id, currency_id, purchase_price, retail_gross, retail_net, website, active, created_date, created_by) SELECT 'Мешок для мусора биг-бэг 1м3', 'Worek na gruz big bag 1m3', t.id, (SELECT id FROM material_producers WHERE name_pl = 'Technicqll' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1), u.id, c.id, 6.50, 11.99, 9.75, 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll', TRUE, NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM construction_material_types t, measurement_units u, currencies c WHERE t.code = 'WOREK_NA_GRUZ' AND u.code = 'szt' AND c.code = 'PLN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM construction_materials cm WHERE cm.name_pl = 'Worek na gruz big bag 1m3' AND cm.website IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'https://www.castorama.pl/s/folia-pod-styropian?Marka=Technicqll' AND cm.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1) AND cm.retail_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 9.75 );

INSERT INTO construction_materials ( name_ru, name_pl, type_id, producer_id, seller_id, unit_id, currency_id, purchase_price, retail_gross, retail_net, website, active, created_date, created_by) SELECT 'Диск алмазный отрезной 125мм', 'Tarcza diamentowa do cięcia 125mm', t.id, (SELECT id FROM material_producers WHERE name_pl = 'Profi' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1), u.id, c.id, 9.80, 17.99, 14.63, 'https://pro-budowa.pl/produkt/tarcza-diamentowa-do-ciecia-gresu-plytek-125-mm/', TRUE, NOW(), 'seed:for-04-19' FROM construction_material_types t, measurement_units u, currencies c WHERE t.code = 'TARCZA_TNACA' AND u.code = 'szt' AND c.code = 'PLN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM construction_materials cm WHERE cm.name_pl = 'Tarcza diamentowa do cięcia 125mm' AND cm.website IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'https://pro-budowa.pl/produkt/tarcza-diamentowa-do-ciecia-gresu-plytek-125-mm/' AND cm.seller_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT id FROM material_sellers WHERE name_pl = 'Castorama' LIMIT 1) AND cm.retail_net IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 14.63 );
